info.title: PBCP head: the human API
info.description: What the owner’s devices call: the brief, cards, decisions, orders, settings. Producers use the PBCP protocol routes instead (RFC §7), which this document does not cover; sign-in (/api/auth/*) is not in it either. Every /api/me request needs `Authorization: Session <access token>` and may carry `X-Timezone`.

session.name: Authorization
session.description: `Session <access token>`, from sign-in or /api/auth/refresh. A producer’s `Bearer` token is refused with 401.

XTimezone.name: X-Timezone
XTimezone.description: The IANA timezone the device is in now, e.g. `Europe/Copenhagen`. Optional on every /api/me request. It is stored on the calling device, and the head follows the zone of the device most recently seen with it (for the brief, the day view, snooze presets and the nightly card) unless the owner set an override in /api/me/settings. An unknown zone, or a bare offset such as `+02:00`, is 400 `invalid_request`, checked after the credential.

until.description: UTC only (`…Z`), later than now; an offset such as `+02:00` is refused with 400 `invalid_snooze`. Null unsnoozes.

timezone.description: Sets the override, which wins over the devices; null clears it

display_name.description: One line, 1–100 characters; null clears it

ceiling.description: Applies to content stored from now on (§9)

revoked.description: Revokes every token of the root; mint a new one to bring it back
